newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs sober up, trapped in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs sober up, trapped in tight range.

text.p: Belgian linear government bonds nursed a delicate hangover on Tuesday after partying on Monday to celebrate smooth proceedings at the EU summit in Amsterdam.
"It's just some profit-taking after the exaggerated optimism yesterday. People simply had a closer look at the agreement, which was not as dramatic as thought at first," one trader said.
European Union leaders approved a budget stability pact and a resolution on boosting employment and growth on Monday, thus maintaining the momentum behind the single currency project.
The benchmark 2007 OLO BE286= yielded 5.79 percent in late trade, up from 5.75 percent on Monday.
U.S. data served as catalysts for weakness in OLOs, which occurred in line with Bunds.
OLOs and Bunds started sagging after 1230 GMT despite a tame when Bund futures FDB: slid below chart support around 101.54 in response to T-bonds weakness US:.
U.S. May industrial output and capacity utilisation at 1315 GMT, however, had no significant impact.
"The U.S. data had no big positive or negative impact, they were already largely discounted," one trader said.

In the short term OLOs were likely to be steady with expectations of a weaker-than-expected euro evened out by the fact that it remained more lucrative for players to invest in bonds than in short-term paper. "The rate curve is so steep that it would be irresponsible not to invest," one trader said.
Political events in Europe were not likely to stir up anxiety, he said. "If even Left's victory at the French elections had no major impact, what would?"
Only strong inflation data could rattle the market, he said.
